jobs.title: Customer Service/Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us:**  
At 6 Degrees Collective, we are an exciting, fast-growing company committed to making a difference in the Personal Care industry. As we continue to expand, we are looking for an energetic and driven **Customer Service/Project Coordinator** to join our team. This role offers a unique opportunity to grow alongside a rapidly evolving company and play a key role in delivering exceptional service and successful projects. If you’re passionate about customer satisfaction, project management, and career advancement, we want to hear from you!

**Position Overview:**  
As a **Customer Service/Project Coordinator**, you will be the bridge between our clients and our internal teams, ensuring projects run smoothly while delivering an outstanding customer experience. You will manage multiple projects, coordinate resources, and communicate effectively with clients to make sure their needs are met. This role requires strong communication skills, organizational abilities, and a passion for problem-solving. It’s a great opportunity to take ownership of your work and contribute directly to the company’s success.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Client Communication:** Act as the primary point of contact for clients, responding to inquiries, addressing concerns, and providing updates on project progress.
* **Project Coordination:** Oversee the planning and execution of projects, ensuring that timelines, quality standards, and client expectations are met.
* **Team Collaboration:** Work closely with internal teams, including sales, operations, and marketing, to ensure seamless project delivery.
* **Problem-Solving:** Resolve issues as they arise, ensuring customer satisfaction and project success while maintaining a positive relationship with clients.
* **Reporting:** Track project milestones, deadlines, and budgets, providing regular updates to both clients and internal stakeholders.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify and implement process improvements to streamline project management and enhance the customer experience.

**Qualifications:**

* **Education:** A **Bachelor’s Degree** is required.
* **Experience:** Previous experience in customer service or project management (1-3 years preferred).
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills in **English**—ability to communicate clearly and effectively with clients and team members.
* **Technical Skills:** Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and project management tools (e.g., Asana, Trello, or similar platforms).
* **Organizational Skills:** Ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* **Problem-Solving:** Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to find solutions quickly and efficiently.
* **Attention to Detail:** High attention to detail to ensure projects meet quality standards and client expectations.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Growth Opportunities:** This role offers excellent opportunities for professional growth and development within a rapidly growing company.
* **Dynamic Environment:** Be part of a fast-paced, innovative team where every day brings new challenges and opportunities.
* **Collaborative Culture:** Join a supportive team where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is key to success.
* **Competitive Compensation:** We offer a competitive salary and benefits package.
* **Impact:** As a key member of our team, your work will directly contribute to the company’s continued growth and success.

**How to Apply:**  
If you're ready to take your career to the next level in a fast-growing company, we'd love to hear from you! Please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing why you’re the perfect fit for this role to HR.recruitment@6degrees.com. We can’t wait to meet you!

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: From $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Ability to Relocate:

* Santa Clarita, CA 91355: Relocate before starting work (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Marketing Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Alabaster is one of the most exciting and fast-growing companies in faith-based publishing today. Founded in Los Angeles, we create beautiful and compelling Christian products — integrating thoughtful design, theological depth, and cultural relevance to help people engage with faith in meaningful ways.

The Marketing Project Coordinator supports the planning, coordination, and execution of marketing campaigns across the business. This role works cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Operations, Inventory, Customer Experience, and Wholesale to ensure campaigns are organized, communicated effectively, and executed on time. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, adaptable, and eager to learn, with strong communication skills and the ability to bring people and projects together in a fast-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate the planning and execution of product launches and marketing campaigns from pre-launch preparation through post-launch review
* Develop and maintain project timelines, milestones, task assignments, and deliverables to keep campaigns on track
* Coordinate cross-functional teams and stakeholders to ensure clear communication, alignment, and timely execution of campaign activities
* Support product launch preparation, including retail pricing, product listings across sales platforms, inventory timelines, and marketing asset availability
* Coordinate website and product page setup, presale preparation, promotional codes, and backend systems to ensure launch readiness
* Coordinate email and SMS marketing execution, working with relevant team members to ensure campaign deliverables are completed on schedule
* Facilitate communication and collaboration across marketing, content, operations, inventory, customer experience, and wholesale teams
* Participate in marketing syncs, campaign ideation meetings, and post-campaign debriefs to track action items, communicate updates, and support ongoing improvements
* Proactively identify project gaps, potential delays, and execution challenges, working with relevant team members to resolve issues
* Conduct post-launch audits to ensure campaign components are functioning as intended and identify opportunities for improvement
* Build and maintain effective project management systems, workflows, and processes to improve marketing campaign efficiency and team communication

**Requirements**

* Strong organizational and time management skills, with excellent attention to detail
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across teams and stakeholders
* Proactive and resourceful, with a willingness to take initiative, follow up, and address challenges independently
* Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to understand different working styles and build effective relationships across teams
* Adaptable and comfortable navigating changing priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Eager to learn, receptive to feedback, and motivated to support the success of the broader team
* Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and competing priorities simultaneously
* Comfortable learning and working with project management tools and platforms

**Bonus Points If You Have**

* Experience in project coordination, event planning, or marketing is a plus, but not required
* Experience working with project management tools and platforms is a plus, but not required

**Benefits**

* The expected salary range for this position is $69,500 to $75,000 per year, depending on experience
* Exceptional health coverage (medical, dental, vision) with 99% of premiums covered by us
* A 401(k) plan with a 3% salary contribution from us, enroll after six months
* Generous paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays
* Enjoy various stipends for work and wellness, and a generous 85% discount on company products
* A collaborative, mission-driven, and growth-oriented work environment
* Opportunity to directly impact the financial strategy of a rapidly growing e-commerce company

jobs.title: Receivership Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Griswold Receivers is seeking a full-time California Receivership Project Coordinator to support the management and oversight of 40–45 active receivership projects. This is a hybrid role that will include traveling to properties across Northern California and Nevada as needed.

In the field, you’ll conduct site inspections, coordinate with city inspectors and contractors to plan and schedule work, manage property needs such as utility setup, fencing, and security, help relocate occupants and tenants, and track overall project progress. The Project Coordinator will report to the Director, Northern California Property Management and work closely with the Operations Team to carry out day-to-day tasks for each project.

The Receivership Project Coordinator will help coordinate receivership projects from start to finish, keeping them on time, on budget, and done well. We’re looking for a proactive team player who likes working with others and takes initiative to keep projects moving. Partnering closely with the Director of Northern California Property Management, this role monitors properties, resolves issues quickly, and plays a key part in carrying out court-appointed receivership responsibilities.

 **Compensation:**

$75,000 - $85,000

 **Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate and oversee multiple receivership projects from start to finish.
* Travel to properties throughout Northern California and Nevada to conduct inspections, monitor progress, and address issues.
* Work with city inspectors, contractors, and vendors to schedule and plan required work.
* Assist with the setup and management of property services, including utilities, fencing, and security.
* Support the relocation of occupants and tenants as needed, including identifying options and coordinating logistics.
* Monitor project timelines to keep projects on track.
* Maintain accurate records of property conditions and work performed, including photos and inspection notes.
* Prepare regular status updates and reports for the Director and Operations Team.
* Respond to urgent property issues such as damage, vandalism, or security concerns.
* Act as a point of contact for tenants and neighbors, handling concerns professionally and maintaining positive relationships.
* Work with internal teams and outside stakeholders to keep projects running efficiently.

 **Qualifications:**

* 1–3 years of property management and/or construction management experience.
* Strong organizational, administrative, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-compliance environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and basic project management tools.

 **About Company**

Griswold Receivers and its professionals serve exclusively as Court-appointed neutrals in a variety of legal scenarios, including health & safety receiverships, tenant habitability receiverships, post-judgment receiverships, business dispute receiverships, rents/profits receiverships, and partition actions. These matters often lead to a variety of types of rehabilitation and construction projects.

We embrace a team-centric environment and approach to support one another in our respective roles, while also remaining flexible and adaptable to take on different roles as the project may require. Our team possesses a high level of integrity and keeps a level head during high-pressure or potentially volatile situations without losing sight of the end goal.

**COMPENSATION & COMPANY BENEFITS INCLUDE:**

Salary is dependent on experience & skillset. Benefits include an incentive plan, 401(k) (after waiting period), paid holidays, wellness reimbursement program, and paid time off.

jobs.title: ProAV Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Supervision**  
  
Reports to: Technical Product Manager

  

**Come grow with us!**

Working at ViewSonic is a unique opportunity to do rewarding, meaningful, high-visibility work for a global leader in visual technology. At ViewSonic, we are celebrating nearly 4 decades of excellence, carrying on the same entrepreneurial spirit and innovation we’ve had since 1987. Our brand and products are well-known throughout the industry. As a result, we are growing quickly and are looking for energetic, motivated team members to expand our nest.

  

**Your Role and Impact**

The **Pro AV Project Coordinator** serves as ViewSonic's primary facilitator for the successful and timely completion of Pro AV projects, including direct-view LED (dvLED), commercial displays, and custom solutions. From the time an order is received through installation and final close-out, this role helps keep all parties aligned throughout the project lifecycle, including integrators, installers, design engineers, Solutions Engineers, Product Management, and end customers.

The Project Coordinator acts as the primary point of contact for on-site activities, coordinating project details and helping ensure work is completed accurately and on schedule. This role also plays an important part in strategic Pro AV rollouts and custom projects, translating Solutions Engineering designs into complete, competitively priced design packages that support opportunities through the next stages of the sales process.

Beyond day-to-day project execution, the Project Coordinator leads the development of scalable standard operating procedures (SOPs) that strengthen efficiency and consistency across Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product Management, and Operations. In close partnership with Product Management, this role will help drive the continued growth of ViewSonic's Pro AV business by creating repeatable processes that allow the team to manage a growing volume of projects while maintaining quality, consistency, and timely execution.

**Day to Day Responsibilities**

* Plan and manage strategic Pro AV rollouts across Commercial Displays, dvLED, and related product lines, including large-scale and multi-site deployments.
* Manage custom projects from start to finish, including scheduling design calls, assembling complete design packages following Solutions Engineering design completion, and coordinating pricing with Product Management.
* Proactively identify project risks, potential delays, and dependencies, driving resolution before they impact project timelines or delivery.
* Coordinate all dvLED orders once received, including reviewing order details, confirming configurations and required accessories, and tracking orders through delivery.
* Manage project timelines and coordinate installation schedules with integrators, installers, and internal teams, serving as the primary point of contact for on-site activities and ensuring site readiness and successful, on-time completion.
* Coordinate escalated troubleshooting efforts, bringing together Solutions Engineering, Service, Engineering, and Product teams to resolve complex issues quickly and effectively.
* Maintain project schedules, status trackers, and supporting documentation throughout the project lifecycle, including key milestones, installation outcomes, and close-out details, while providing regular updates to Sales, Product Management, customers, and other key stakeholders.
* Lead the development and continuous improvement of scalable SOPs for key Pro AV workflows, including order intake, installation scheduling, troubleshooting escalation, design packages, and project close-out, to improve efficiency and consistency across teams.
* Support industry trade shows, conferences, and events, such as InfoComm, as needed.

**Your Profile**

**Required Qualifications**

* Associate degree or higher in Business Administration, Project Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 2+ years of experience coordinating projects in the Pro AV market
* Experience working with AV integrators, design engineers, project managers, and installers
* Working knowledge of project management principles, scheduling, and resource coordination
* Familiarity with Pro AV systems, including dvLED, commercial displays, and signal distribution
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines at once in a fast-paced environment
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Strong communication, customer service, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work across internal teams and external partners
* Proficiency with MS Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CTS (Certified Technology Specialist) certification
* Manufacturer certifications such as Extron, Q-SYS, or other Pro AV manufacturer certifications
* Experience with dvLED installation projects, including familiarity with ViewSonic, Samsung, LG, Planar, Absen, Daktronics, or similar platforms
* Prior experience working for a display or AV manufacturer or AV integrator
* Familiar with project management tools
* Ability to read architectural, electrical, and AV design drawings

**What’s in it for you:**

* Medical, Dental and Vision insurance options
* 401k with company match

**Work Environment & Requirements**

* **Office Presence**: Hybrid: 3 days in office, 2 days local off-site

* **Travel:** Up to 10%, including occasional site visits, project kickoffs, and industry trade shows

jobs.title: Program Specialist
jobs.description:
At **Wayfinder Family Services**, we understand the unique challenges facing some of our state’s most vulnerable children, youth and adults. Those with disabilities, those without a home of their own, those who have been abused and many, many more. We answer the call for them. We believe in the amazing potential in, and for, each and every one of them. And, together, we find a way to turn that potential into reality.

**Role Summary:**

The primary focus of the **Program Specialist** is to provide administrative, operational, and customer service support for the Relative Home Assessment Services (RHAS) Program. This position serves as a key point of contact for relative and non-relative extended family member (NREFM) caregivers, county partners, social workers, and agency staff throughout the assessment and approval process. The Program Specialist is responsible for ensuring timely processing of referrals, maintaining accurate records, coordinating appointments and trainings, tracking regulatory timelines, and supporting program staff in achieving compliance with applicable regulations, contractual requirements, and agency standards.

The hourly wage range for this role is $25.00 - $26.00.

**This position is eligible for a a $1,000 sign-on bonus.**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Track Household Purchase Records submissions and ensure all required documentation is submitted and processed within the contractual timeframe.
* Track satisfaction surveys with RHAS families.
* Ensure integrity of clients’ records through accurate filing and updating of chart materials and ensure all centralized files and file cabinets are secured during business hours.
* Assist in the coordination, organization, and logistical support of ongoing groups and program activities such as arranging meeting space, confirming attendance, and providing additional support as needed.
* Maintain and distribute agency rosters and logs.
* Sort and file all correspondence, reports, records, documents, or other materials, search files to retrieve information as requested.
* Provide clerical/ reception/ office administrative duties. Greet visitors and take telephone calls, refer visitors and callers to appropriate staff or offices.
* Receive, open, date-stamps, and route mail. Addresses and processes all outgoing mail.
* Track, monitor, and document the completion of all required Resource Family Approval (RFA) training modules as part of the initial approval process, ensuring compliance with applicable ongoing training requirements and established deadlines.
* Perform other duties as may become necessary or as directed.

**Education and Experience:**

* High school diploma or higher and 4 years' experience in office and customer service.
* Experience in child welfare, foster care, social services, family services, behavioral health, or nonprofit programs preferred.
* Experience coordinating services, managing databases, and maintaining confidential records preferred.
* Experience working with relative caregivers, resource families, or child welfare programs is highly desirable.
* Bilingual (Spanish), required.
* Valid California Driver’s License with a minimum of three (3) years of good driving history and must be approved by the agency’s insurance carrier to drive agency vehicles.

**Benefits**: Wayfinder is committed to providing our employees with a benefits program that is both comprehensive and competitive which includes:

* Paid Time Off: Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) policy, 11 paid holidays, plus five winter holidays
* Medical, dental, vision, life, and long-term disability insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan with employer match up to 4%
* Employee referral program: Encourage your colleagues to join us
* Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) eligible
* Flexible spending account (FSA) plans
* Eligibility and other benefits are outlined in plan documents

***Wayfinder Family Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We support a drug-free workplace and conduct pre-employment background and drug screenings.***

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Overview**

**About LedgerWay**

LedgerWay is a growing accounting, tax, and advisory firm serving clients through a network of offices across the country. As we welcome new firms and teams, our Operations Support group keeps day-to-day work moving across our tax, accounting, and advisory teams.

**Role Summary**

The Operations Coordinator is a full-time member of the Operations Support Team. Based in downtown Los Angeles, CA and reporting to the Manager-Operations Support, you will provide administrative support to our tax practice: processing and e-filing returns, billing clients (including monthly recurring accounting and tax engagements), coordinating client documents and communication, and handling internal special projects. This role suits someone organized and dependable who knows the tax season workflow and can work independently, both in the office and remotely.

**Responsibilities**

**Tax Return Processing and Filling**

▪Assemble, finalize, and deliver completed tax returns to clients through the client portal, email, or mail.

▪Prepare and send e-file authorizations (such as Forms 8879 and 8878) and engagement letters, and follow up until they are signed.

▪E-file returns and extensions once authorized, monitor acceptances, and work with preparers to resolve rejections.

▪Track filing deadlines, extensions, and estimated payment vouchers, and keep return status current in Financial Cents.

▪Log incoming IRS and state notices, route them to the right preparer, and track responses to closure.

**Client Intake and Coordination**

▪Send tax organizers, engagement letters, and document request lists, and track receipt of client documents.

▪Serve as a first point of contact for administrative client questions, and schedule client meetings for the tax team.

▪Maintain accurate client records, contact details, and client groups in Financial Cents.

▪Run client onboarding and offboarding steps using LedgerWay’s Financial Cents checklist templates.

**Client Billing and Collections**

▪Run monthly recurring billing for clients on recurring engagements, such as accounting, bookkeeping, and tax preparation, and confirm each invoice matches the client’s engagement terms before it goes out.

▪Update recurring invoices when clients add, change, or end services, and flag pricing questions to the Manager - Operations Support.

▪Prepare and send one-time invoices when returns and projects are completed, following engagement terms and pricing.

▪Review unbilled time and draft invoices with tax managers before release.

▪Apply payments, follow up on outstanding balances using the AR aging report, and record collection notes in Financial Cents.

**Internal Special Projects**

▪Lead or support internal projects assigned by the Manager-Operations Support, such as process documentation, client data cleanup, and workflow improvements.

▪Help newly joined offices adopt LedgerWay tax workflows,templates, and software.

▪Prepare tracking lists and status reports for tax season, extensions, and other initiatives.

▪Take on other administrative and operational tasks as assigned.

**Qualifications**

**▪**High school diploma or equivalent, at minimum.

▪One to two years of administrative or client service experience, ideally at an accounting or tax firm.

▪A client-first attitude: friendly, responsive, and professional in every call and email.

▪A working understanding of the tax season workflow, including efile authorizations and filing deadlines.

▪Comfortable handling client billing and payment follow-up with tact and clear communication.

▪Organized and dependable, so client requests and deadlines never slip through the cracks.

▪Comfortable with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Teams) and trusted with confidential client information.

Pay: $70,000.00 - $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA 90014

jobs.description:

jobs.description:
**About Yumwoof**

Yumwoof is a fast-growing premium dog food brand focused on creating better, healthier food for dogs. As we continue expanding our retail and distribution footprint across the U.S., we are looking for a motivated and passionate **Field Sales Representative** (**based in California, Nevada, Washington, Oregon, and/or Florida**) to help us build strong relationships with our retail partners and support our growth in the market.

**About the Role**

As a Field Sales Representative at Yumwoof, you will be the face of our brand for independent pet retailers in your territory.

Your primary responsibility will be to support our retail partners, work closely with our distributors and their sales teams, and make sure Yumwoof is represented successfully at store level.

This is a hands-on field role with **approximately 75% travel within your assigned territory.** You will spend significant time visiting stores, building relationships with store owners and managers, training retail teams, supporting distributor sales representatives, and identifying opportunities to grow Yumwoof within existing and new independent accounts. You will also actively prospect for new business through **in-person visits to independent pet retailers** within your territory.

**This role can also be a great fit for someone currently working in pet retail.** If you are an experienced store manager, assistant manager, department lead, or retail team member who knows the pet industry, understands how independent pet stores operate, and is ready to take the next step in your career, we would love to hear from you.

We care about your ability to connect with people, understand retailers, learn quickly, take ownership, and represent Yumwoof with enthusiasm.

**What You'll Do**

* Visit independent pet retailers throughout your assigned territory
* Build strong relationships with store owners, managers, and retail teams
* Educate and train store employees on Yumwoof products, ingredients, benefits, and key selling points
* Conduct product trainings, store visits, and in-store demonstrations
* Work closely with our distribution partners and participate in distributor sales rep ride-alongs
* Support distributor sales representatives with product knowledge and retailer conversations
* Help introduce Yumwoof to new retail locations within the territory
* Increase product visibility, placement, and assortment within existing accounts
* Ensure Yumwoof products, displays, and marketing materials are properly represented in stores
* Identify stores that need additional support, training, samples, or marketing materials
* Help drive reorders and improve sales performance within existing retail accounts
* Gather feedback from retailers and communicate market insights back to the Yumwoof team
* Track store visits, trainings, opportunities, and follow-up actions
* Attend distributor events, trade shows, retailer events, and other industry events as needed
* Collaborate closely with Yumwoof's Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams

You’ll work with homeowners, property managers, building owners, landlords, and HOAs, managing opportunities from the first appointment through signed contracts and a thorough handoff to production.

**Exceptional follow-up is a must—especially on commercial proposals.** We need someone who takes ownership after an estimate is sent, stays engaged with decision-makers, and keeps every opportunity moving forward.

What You’ll Do

* **Sell residential and commercial roofing:** Roof replacements, reroofing, repairs, and commercial service and preventative maintenance programs.
* **Inspect and assess roofing needs:** Conduct on-site inspections, document conditions with photos and measurements, and recommend appropriate solutions.
* **Quote roof repairs:** Prepare clear, accurate repair estimates for residential and commercial properties, coordinating with production when technical input is needed.
* **Prepare professional proposals:** Clearly explain scope of work, pricing, materials, warranties, and available financing options.
* **Own the follow-up process:** Confirm proposals were received, schedule follow-up conversations, answer questions, address objections, and ask for the sale.
* **Manage commercial sales cycles:** Identify decision-makers, understand budgets and approval timelines, and stay engaged through property manager, ownership, or HOA review.
* **Build recurring business:** Develop commercial maintenance relationships and opportunities for future repairs, replacements, referrals, and additional properties.
* **Manage your pipeline:** Keep CRM records current with inspection notes, proposal status, customer communications, and a scheduled next action for every open opportunity.
* **Work independently:** Organize your appointments, travel, estimates, and follow-up activities while meeting established sales and activity goals.
* **Support a smooth production handoff:** Submit complete contracts, photos, measurements, and scope details so the team can deliver what was sold.
* Generate additional business through referrals, networking, and relationships with local property owners and managers.

Who We’re Looking For

* **At least 2 years of roofing sales experience**, with the ability to handle both residential and commercial opportunities.
* Ability to assess and quote residential and commercial roof repairs—not just full replacements.
* Working knowledge of residential roofing and commercial low-slope roofing systems.
* Familiarity with commercial roofing service and preventative maintenance programs.
* **Outstanding follow-up habits:** Persistent, professional, organized, and reliable.
* Proven ability to manage longer sales cycles and communicate with multiple decision-makers.
* Strong presentation, negotiation, relationship-building, and closing skills.
* Comfortable using a CRM, preparing proposals, documenting inspections, and managing a sales pipeline.
* A self-starter who can produce results without daily reminders or constant supervision.
* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.
* Ability to safely access roofs and conduct inspections following company safety procedures.
* Availability for evening and weekend appointments as needed.
* Spanish-speaking ability is a plus.

What We Offer

* **Company-provided commercial and residential leads.**
* Competitive commission structure with uncapped earning potential.
* Multiple sales opportunities: replacements, repairs, and commercial maintenance.
* Ongoing training, product education, and support from experienced roofing professionals.
* Company-branded apparel, marketing support, and inspection tools.
* A team focused on quality workmanship, customer service, and long-term relationships.
* Growth opportunities as we expand across Southern California

How to Apply

Apply through Indeed with your resume. Please include a brief summary of your residential and commercial roofing experience, including your experience estimating repairs and selling maintenance services.

Send a short introduction email.

* What is your name, and where are you located?
* What experience do you have selling residential and commercial roofing?
* Have you personally quoted roof repairs or sold commercial maintenance programs?
* What is your follow-up process after sending a commercial estimate?
* Why would you be a strong addition to our team?

**If you know roofing, take ownership of your opportunities, and understand that consistent follow-up wins business, we want to hear from you.**

jobs.description:
**Main Purpose of the Role:**

Support the Marine Operations Manager in ensuring premium service for our Expedite Product and coordinating vessel-arrival and sailing functions for designated West Coast ports in accordance with the Collective Bargaining Agreement and established operational procedures. Maintain daily coordination with terminals regarding berth windows, yard-space allocation, labor requirements, vessel productivity, stowage, discharge, and cargo availability. Assist with the coordination of pilotage, docking, and operational matters involving USCG, CBP, MTOs, stevedore vendors, and other government agencies and external partners. Help ensure the Expedite product is discharged and available within established service-level agreements (SLAs) across all calling terminals, working closely with ZIM Planning and Terminal Planning teams to optimize vessel stowage and prioritize designated containers. Support labor planning, contractual compliance, OOG and breakbulk cargo coordination, vendor invoice review and reconciliation, post-vessel reporting, and tracking of cost-saving opportunities. Provide day-to-day operational follow-up, problem resolution, reporting, vendor coordination, and coverage for the Marine Operations Manager, while supporting customer, terminal, vessel, and other Branch operational needs as assigned.

**Main Tasks:**

Monitor Expedite discharge and availability against SLA across three calling terminals; follow up on and escalate service exceptions.

Maintain daily contact with terminals regarding berth windows, yard-space allocation, labor requirements, productivity, cargo cutoffs, and operational constraints.

Coordinate with ZIM Planning and Terminal Planning teams to support optimized vessel stowage and loading/discharge sequences for priority containers.

Coordinate terminal resource needs to support efficient wheeled operations and monitor vessel activity before arrival and throughout the port stay.

Monitor cold-treatment reefer containers, container activity at the port, and compliance with loading and discharge policies.

Support cost-effective labor-ordering decisions by providing operational information to the Marine Operations Manager and terminal stevedores; review stevedoring invoices for adherence and accuracy.

Support the Marine Operations Manager with daily work coordination, operational coverage, process follow-up, and communication across the department.

Assist with workload tracking, resource coordination, task prioritization, schedules, and operational handoffs.

Provide guidance to employees on established procedures and escalate performance, staffing, or employee-relations matters to the Marine Operations Manager.

Support onboarding and training of new employees and help prepare weekly department meetings, reports, and follow-up items.

Assist with proactive planning for vessel operations, service levels, equipment requirements, and coordination with Branch departments.

Identify and recommend cost-saving opportunities within Marine Operations.

Prepare pricing support and coordinate required approvals for import and export OOG and breakbulk shipments at designated ports.

Support coordination of dangerous, complex, and special cargo and route authorization requests in accordance with applicable terminal and port policies.

Maintain effective working relationships with Expedite service terminals and internal stakeholders in the Los Angeles office.

Work with major shippers of High Value Cargo to coordinate delivery of their cargo prior to or directly to the vessel or truck during cargo operations.

Coordinate daily vessel information and solve complex terminal, vessel, customer, and cargo-flow problems.

  
Requirements:  
  

* Academic education: Maritime College Degree, Shipboard experience, Maritime operational experience.
* Experience: 3-5 years relevant Maritime Industry experience.
* Experience in the shipping/transportation industry in Operations or equivalent is highly preferred.
* Experience working in Union Labor environment and contract knowledge.
* Experience in Stevedoring ( a plus )

jobs.description:
**A LITTLE ABOUT BEEK**

beek is a luxury footwear and accessories brand based in Newport Beach, California, founded in 2014 by two friends, Birgit and Kenna, who share a love for beautiful design, quality leather, and exceptional craftsmanship.

Our philosophy is simple: create timeless, beautifully made pieces that feel as incredible as they look. We believe in quality over quantity, craftsmanship over trends, and designing pieces that only get better with age. What began as a collection of leather footwear has grown to include handbags and accessories, all with the same commitment to thoughtful design, beautiful materials, and uncompromising comfort.

Giving back has also been part of our story since day one. Every pair of shoes sold helps provide meals to children in need through our longtime partnership with Second Harvest Food Bank of Orange County. It's a part of our business that means a great deal to us.

**And the team behind beek?** We're a close-knit group of creative, hardworking people who genuinely enjoy what we do. We're collaborative, entrepreneurial, and passionate about the details. We move quickly, wear a lot of hats, and believe that great ideas can come from anyone. We take our work seriously, but we don't take ourselves too seriously.

We're continuing to grow and are always excited to bring talented, thoughtful people into the mix.

**Position Overview**

**THE ROLE: INFLUENCER MARKETING SPECIALIST**

We're looking for a creative, organized, and relationship-driven Influencer Marketing Specialist to focus on, grow and manage beek's network of influencers, content creators, and VIPs.

You will oversee our influencer program across Instagram and Tiktok, including identifying partners, outreach, building relationships, coordinating product gifting, negotiating collaborations, managing contracts, and ensuring content is delivered. You will also manage our ShopMy affiliate program and all promotional product shipments.

Working closely with our Social Content Coordinator, you'll help identify which creators, partnerships, and content are driving the best results and find ways to leverage that content across social media, advertising, email, and our website to ultimately drive top line revenue.

* **Creator Collaborations:** Identify and manage paid and gifted partnerships, including negotiations, contracts, content briefs, timelines, and usage rights. Coordinate creator content shoots as needed.
* **Content & Performance:** Partner with our Social Content Coordinator to evaluate results, identify high-performing creators and content, and maximize the use of that content across social, paid advertising, email, and web.

**QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS**

* 3+ years of experience in influencer marketing or creator partnerships, preferably within fashion, lifestyle, or a consumer brand.

**About the job**
-----------------

**Cuttable exists because creativity shouldn’t be what slows marketing teams down.**

The world’s biggest advertising platforms demand more ads than most teams can produce. But production is still slow, expensive and built for a different era. Briefs pile up. Creative teams burn out. Marketers can’t keep up.

Cuttable fixes that.

We’re an AI Creative Production System that helps ecommerce brands create, test and launch ads across Meta, TikTok and Google at the volume the platforms actually reward.

More than 300 brands across North America and Asia Pacific already use Cuttable. We’re backed by Square Peg, Rampersand and AirTree, following one of the largest seed rounds in Australian tech history. Offices in Melbourne and New York.

Our CEO and co-founder, Sam Kroonenburg, has built and scaled a global technology company before. Now we’re doing it again.

**Join us and help make good ads, instantly.**

### **The role**

**Pay range: $101,000 – $151,000 USD per year** — the range we reasonably expect to pay for this role at hire.

As Cuttable scales its US customer base, our customers need someone who owns their success long after onboarding. As a Customer Success Manager, you’ll own retention, adoption and expansion across a book of US customers from day 90 onward, including every renewal in that book. You’ll be the trusted advisor customers call for ideas, not just support, and you’ll treat retention and growth as your number, acting independently and never waiting for permission to save or grow an account.

You’ll report to the Customer Success Director and partner day to day with Implementation, Sales, Product and Support. This role is based in San Francisco, in the office at least 2 days per week (hybrid).

**What you’ll own**

* Retention, adoption and expansion across a book of US customers from day 90 onward, including every renewal.
* The customer relationship after the day-90 handover from Implementation.
* Account health across your book: using usage, health and engagement data to spot at-risk renewals early and act before they land.
* Your number: hitting or beating your renewal and expansion quota once it is set in Q1 2027.

**What you’ll drive**

* Product adoption and expansion (more brands, more users, bigger plans and more of customers’ spend on Cuttable creative) by tying Cuttable to the numbers they care about, like ROAS and CPA.
* Expansion conversations that lead with value, not a pitch, starting from the customer’s goals and results.
* Business reviews and success plans that make the value obvious to decision-makers at every level, from paid social leads to CMOs.
* Customer advocacy: referrals, case studies and champions inside customer teams.
* Smart prioritisation, so multi-brand teams and fast-moving single brands each get the attention that matches what’s at stake.
* Improvements to our renewal and expansion playbook, contributing what’s working in your book as we build the motion in the US.

**Who you’ll support**

* Implementation Managers, by agreeing a clean day-90 handover so customers never feel the change of owner.
* Account Executives, by flagging expansion opportunities and sharing account context ahead of commercial conversations.
* Product, by sharing customer feedback, feature requests and patterns you see across your book.
* Newer team members, through informal mentoring, coaching and empathetic feedback.
* The Customer Success Director, with input on how CSM quotas and variable comp should be measured.

**What success looks like at six months**

* Customers are using more of Cuttable (more brands, more users, more of their spend on Cuttable creative) because you tied it to the numbers they care about, like ROAS and CPA.
* Revenue across your book is growing, and you saw at-risk renewals coming well before they landed.
* Customers call you for advice, not just support. You bring ideas before they ask and do what you say you’ll do.
* Your time matches what’s at stake: multi-brand teams and fast-moving single brands each get the attention they need.
* Your best customers are your best pipeline, referring peers, joining case studies and championing Cuttable inside their own teams.
* You’re on track to hit or exceed your quota from Q1 2027, and you’ve contributed to a renewal and expansion playbook the team uses.

### **Who we look for**

We hire for values as much as experience, because mindset carries you through the parts no job description can predict. Here’s what that looks like day to day at Cuttable:

* **Be Brave & Own It**: you take smart risks and you own what happens next, good or bad. You own the outcome, not just the intention.
* **Create Customer Magic**: you listen hard enough to get to what customers actually need, not just what they said.
* **Say It (With Care)**: You say the honest thing, directly, and with genuine care for the person hearing it.
* **Progress Beats Perfection**: you’d rather ship, learn, and improve than sit on something waiting for it to be flawless.
* **Work Hard, Laugh Often**: you take the work seriously. Never yourself.

We believe you’ll succeed in this role if you have:

* Demonstrated experience as a Customer Success Manager, Account Manager or Account Executive in B2B SaaS, with a track record of growing revenue through renewals, expansion and product adoption, and of hitting or beating your number.
* Experience managing a mix of account sizes, from fast-moving brands to multi-stakeholder teams, and the ability to build trust with decision-makers at every level, from paid social leads to CMOs.
* Strong storytelling: business reviews and success plans that make the value obvious.
* A data-driven way of running your book. Usage, health and engagement tell you where to focus, and you know when to pull in peers or the Customer Success Director for help.
* Comfort using tools like HubSpot, Intercom (or similar), Notion, Loom and Slack.
* Bonus: working knowledge of performance ma

**What you’ll do**

* **Make short-form video, a lot of it.** Product walkthroughs, quick takes on what’s working in Meta ads, before-and-afters, event clips. You’ll be on camera often and get better every week.
* **Run founder content.** Get ideas out of our founders, run recording sessions, edit, and post on LinkedIn and X in a voice that sounds like them, not like marketing.
* **Write.** LinkedIn posts, scripts, newsletter pieces and launch copy.
* **Bring launches to life.** When we ship something, you’ll make the content that shows it working, built with the Senior PMM.
* **Be our person at US events.** We do a handful a year, like trade show booths and our own dinners. You’ll help run them with a freelance producer and turn every one into a week of content.
* **Work with creators and editors.** Brief our editor, find creators our buyers already follow, and get collaborations live.

**What a normal week looks like**

8–10 founder posts shipped, 2–3 short videos of your own, and some writing. You’ll make plenty of it in Cuttable itself and use AI tools to turn one recording into a week of posts. Some things will flop. That’s fine. Most good content does after a few misses.

* **You’ll have a budget** for an editor, gear and freelance help for events.

**What success looks like**

Within 90 days:

* Founder content ships every week without anyone chasing it.
* You’re on camera for Cuttable regularly, and people in our world are starting to recognise you.
* You’ve run content at your first US event.

Within 12 months:

* Cuttable and its founders are known voices on Meta creative among the people we sell to.
* Prospects tell sales they found us through our content, and we can see it on the demo form.

**This won’t be the right role if you**

* Don’t want to be on camera.
* Prefer polishing one thing for a month to shipping something every day.
* Need detailed briefs before you start.

### **Who we look for**

* **Be Brave & Own It**: you take smart risks and you own what happens next, good or bad. You own the outcome, not just the intention.
* **Create Customer Magic**: you listen hard enough to get to what customers actually need, not just what they said.
* **Say It (With Care)**: You say the honest thing, directly, and with genuine care for the person hearing it.
* **Progress Beats Perfection**: you’d rather ship, learn, and improve than sit on something waiting for it to be flawless.
* **Work Hard, Laugh Often**: you take the work seriously. Never yourself.

We believe you’ll succeed in this role if you:

* **Have 1–4 years making content,** at a startup, an agency, a brand or for yourself. If you’re earlier than that but your work is great, apply anyway.
* **Know what interesting looks like.** You can tell why a hook works and why a video lost people at second three, and you have opinions about it.
* **Make things without being asked.** You have a channel, a newsletter, side projects or a body of posts you’re proud of. Show us.
* **Are comfortable on camera.** You don’t need to be polished. You just need to be clear, natural and willing.
* **Can shoot and cut on your own.** A phone, CapCut or Premiere, and a decent ear for pacing.
* **Write clearly and fast.**
* **Are curious about ads and ecommerce,** or already obsessed with them. You’ll learn how performance marketers think: ROAS, creative fatigue, Meta Ads Manager.

jobs.title: Customer Success Lead
jobs.description:
**About Bobyard**

Construction is a multi-trillion-dollar industry facing a shortage of roughly 349,000 workers — and it still estimates by hand. Contractors spend weeks measuring and counting materials off drawings, and that caps how many jobs they can bid. Bobyard’s AI takes a contractor from a set of plans to a bid in minutes instead of weeks. Our customers run real construction jobs on Bobyard, not demos. We raised a $35M Series A led by 8VC, with Primary and Pear.

**Who we are**

Builders. We ship real product to real contractors. If it doesn’t survive contact with a live job, it doesn’t count — we don’t do demo-ware.

Owners. There’s no layer between you and the problem, and no permission slip required. When you see the solution, you own it, end to end.

Independent minds. Strong convictions, open minds. We hire for how you think, not where you learned it — show us the work, not the résumé.

Fast movers. We decide quickly and optimize for impact, not consensus. You’ll be judged by the people in the problem with you, on what you deliver.

**About the role**

Our CSM team is growing faster than one leader can coach. You'll lead a pod of Customer Success Managers, own their retention and expansion numbers, and build the playbook the next pods will run on. You'll still take the hardest accounts yourself.

**What you'll do**

* Lead, coach, and hire a pod of CSMs, and set the bar for what good looks like
* Own your pod's gross and net revenue retention, and know where every account stands each week
* Spot stalling accounts early, and run the save plan yourself when it matters
* Drive renewals, upsells, and win-backs with your team
* Take customers from Implementation without a gap, and turn their feedback into product fixes with Product
* Build the coverage model, health signals, and dashboards that show where to hire and what to automate
* Jump on the hardest customer calls, from estimators to owners

**What we're looking for**

* 6+ years in B2B SaaS customer success or account management, with 2+ years leading CSMs
* You've managed hundreds of SMB or mid-market accounts, not a dozen whales
* You know your team's GRR, NRR, and churn cold, and can show what you personally moved
* Commercial instinct. You're comfortable owning renewal and expansion targets
* You coach in the details: call reviews, account plans, weekly numbers
* Comfortable training non-technical field users

**Nice to have**

* Construction, trades, or field-service software experience
* Built customer success operations on HubSpot and Intercom
* Scaled a CS team through a period of fast growth

**A note on pace**

We move fast, and priorities shift as we learn from customers. Playbooks, context, and requirements are often incomplete when work starts, and you'll be expected to shape them. If that pace excites you, you'll fit in well.

**What we offer**

Cash for stability. Bonus for performance. Equity for ownership. Your package reflects your role, your experience, and what you deliver, and it grows as you do.

* 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4%
* Catered lunch in the office and $70 a month toward your commute

Come build with us!

jobs.title: Operations & Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Corvus**
----------------

We’re Corvus Robotics, a Physical AI company transforming how the world’s warehouses operate. By combining autonomous robotics, computer vision, and AI, we’re replacing manual, labor-intensive processes with intelligent systems that make inventory management safer, smarter, and more efficient.

Our flagship Corvus One drones autonomously track warehouse inventory around the clock, while Corvus Trident, our AI-powered forklift intelligence system, captures inventory movement in real time. Together, our technologies provide a complete picture of warehouse operations, helping enterprises improve accuracy, efficiency, and decision-making.

Our technology is widely deployed and delivering value for leading enterprises. We’re now building a future where warehouse operations are fully autonomous. At Corvus, you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, solve challenging real-world problems, and help bring the next generation of intelligent robots to scale.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a highly organized, resourceful, and hands-on Operations & Logistics Coordinator to support our growing robotics manufacturing operations.

You'll help keep our production and shipping operations running smoothly by managing inventory, coordinating purchasing, tracking incoming materials, and ensuring finished hardware reaches customers on time.

This is not a traditional desk-based logistics role. You'll be actively involved in day-to-day operations, working closely with manufacturing technicians, engineers, and vendors while managing both administrative and physical tasks.

The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys solving operational problems, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is equally comfortable managing purchase orders, organizing inventory, and preparing shipments.

This is a fully onsite role at our Mountain View headquarters, five days a week.

**What You'll Do**

* Manage day-to-day inventory operations, including receiving, organizing, tracking, and maintaining hardware components and supplies.
* Create, track, and manage purchase orders for manufacturing materials, tools, and equipment.
* Coordinate with vendors and suppliers to ensure timely delivery of parts and materials.
* Monitor inventory levels, identify shortages, and support procurement planning.
* Organize and maintain warehouse, storage, and manufacturing areas.
* Coordinate incoming and outgoing shipments, including packaging, labeling, documentation, and carrier scheduling.
* Work closely with manufacturing technicians and quality engineers to ensure materials and finished products are available when needed.
* Maintain accurate inventory records and update internal tracking systems.
* Assist with packing crates, preparing customer shipments, and safely moving hardware and equipment.
* Track shipping deadlines, resolve logistics issues, and communicate updates across teams.
* Support general office and operational needs as required.
* Identify opportunities to improve purchasing, inventory accuracy, shipping workflows, and operational efficiency.

**What We're Looking For**

* Experience in operations, logistics, inventory management, purchasing, shipping, or a related coordination role.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Experience managing multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfortable working with inventory tracking systems, spreadsheets, and operational software.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams.
* Willingness to handle both administrative responsibilities and hands-on physical tasks.
* Ability to safely lift, move, and organize boxes, equipment, and materials, with or without reasonable accommodation.
* Resourceful, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of day-to-day operational challenges.
* Ability to work onsite in Mountain View five days per week.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in robotics, hardware manufacturing, or startup operations.
* Familiarity with purchasing, inventory management, ERP systems, and shipping logistics.
* Experience coordinating warehouse operations and production workflows.
* Background in administrative or office operations with hands-on logistics experience.
* Familiarity with AI tools and process automation.

**Why Join Corvus Robotics?**

**Build technology that works in the real world.** Be part of a team bringing autonomous robotics and AI into real-world environments, solving meaningful challenges and transforming warehouse operations.

**Own your impact.** Take ownership of meaningful work, contribute to important decisions, and see the direct impact of your contributions as we grow.

**Help scale the next generation of Physical AI.** Join at a pivotal stage of growth and help build the technology, teams, systems, and processes that will bring autonomous robotics to enterprise scale.

**Grow alongside the company.** Work with talented, driven people across disciplines, tackle new challenges, expand your skills, and help shape the future of Corvus Robotics.

Compensation Range: $70K - $90K

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
jobs.description:
Reporting directly to the Chief of Staff (CoS), the Executive Assistant to the CEO is the senior administrative partner to the Chief Executive Officer and the Chief of Staff. This role owns the systems, workflows, and standards that govern how the Office of the CEO is accessed and operates. You will exercise delegated authority over the CEO's time, access, and administrative commitments. It sets priorities, resolves scheduling conflicts, and acts on behalf of the CEO and Chief of Staff on matters that do not require their direct involvement. It manages the administrative operations of the executive office end to end. This includes forward planning of the CEO's calendar around Governing Board and organizational cycles. Additionally, it involves preparation and quality control of executive and Board materials. Furthermore, it coordinates executive-level meetings and events. The Executive Assistant serves as the primary contact for the Office of the CEO with staff, Governing Board members, and external parties, and handles confidential and sensitive matters. You will be the resource on executive support practice across the organization, setting the standards that administrative staff follow when working with the CEO's office.

This is a hybrid position, based in our Downtown San Francisco office. Please note that while SFHP supports a hybrid work environment, you are required to be onsite and in-office a minimum of 4 days per month. Beginning in early 2027, the minimum onsite requirement is expected to increase to 8 days per month.

Salary: $100,000 - $120,000 per year

**WHAT YOU WILL DO:**

* Manage the CEO and Chief of Staff calendars with delegated authority to accept, decline, reschedule, and prioritize requests for their time, resolving conflicts based on organizational priorities and standing direction.
* Design the annual CEO calendar structure around Governing Board cycles, strategic planning milestones, compliance deadlines, and recurring organizational commitments, and plan forward to protect time for priority work.
* Screen visitors, calls, correspondence, and meeting requests directed to the CEO, resolving administrative and scheduling matters within delegated authority and routing substantive matters to the Chief of Staff or the accountable executive.
* Be the primary contact for the Office of the CEO, responding to inquiries that require an understanding of SFHP operations, procedures, and priorities, and ensuring professional follow-up.
* Make high-level sensitive contacts inside and outside the organization on behalf of the CEO and Chief of Staff.
* Prepare, edit, and quality check correspondence, reports, and presentations for the CEO and Chief of Staff to a publication-ready standard.
* Assemble briefing packets, pre-read materials, and background files for CEO meetings and engagements, obtaining inputs from departments and resolving gaps before deadlines.
* Compile research and background information from internal and public sources at the request of the CEO and Chief of Staff, and summarize findings for their review.
* Coordinate Governing Board meeting logistics, including the materials production timeline, packet assembly, member communications, and meeting-day support and hospitality, and serve as a regular point of contact for Governing Board members.
* Plan and coordinate executive-level meetings, offsites, conferences, and events, including agendas, materials, vendors, space, and technology.
* Coordinate meetings involving multiple stakeholders and Executive Team presence in partnership with department administrative staff and external parties.
* Record and distribute minutes for designated executive meetings and track resulting action items through to closure.
* Maintain the commitment and follow-up tracking system for the Office of the CEO, monitoring due dates, prompting assigned owners, and reporting outstanding items to the CEO and Chief of Staff.
* Alert the CEO and Chief of Staff to issues requiring immediate attention and follow up on pending matters.
* Manage complex, frequent travel for the CEO and Chief of Staff, anticipating logistical needs and resolving disruptions, and reconcile and process related expense reports.
* Monitor the Office of the CEO administrative budget, track expenditures against plan, and process invoices and expense reimbursements.
* Develop, document, and improve the workflows, templates, filing systems, and tracking tools used to run the Office of the CEO, including records management consistent with public records requirements.
* Establish standards for scheduling requests, materials submission, and communication with the Office of the CEO, and guide department administrative staff in applying them.
* Manage confidential materials and communications, including personnel, legal, and pre-decisional matters, with confidentiality.

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING:**

* High School Diploma or General Education Development (GED) required; Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience in administrative services
* Minimum seven years of experience performing administrative support tasks for senior or executive-level management, including direct support of a CEO or C-suite executive
* Experience exercising delegated authority over an executive's calendar, correspondence, and commitments in a fast-paced, complex environment
* Experience managing complex scheduling, offsite meetings, and frequent travel for executives
* Experience supporting a governing board, board of directors, or other public body

**WHAT WE OFFER:**

* Health Benefits
  + Medical: You'll have a choice of medical plans, including options from Kaiser and Blue Shield of California, heavily subsidized by SFHP.
  + Dental: You'll have a choice of a basic dental plan or an enhanced dental plan which includes orthodontic coverage.
  + Vision: Employee vision care coverage is available through Vision Service Plan (VSP).
* Retirement – Employer-matched CalPERS Pension and 401(a) plans,

Integration Charter School is dedicated to providing innovative pathways to college that fully integrate students living with emotional challenges and others with special needs. In building a family of associated schools that share this common mission, ICS strives to fill gaps in public education. Through our wraparound service model, we remove obstacles and meet every child and family exactly where they are.

  

Summary

The Events & Development Assistant powers the fundraising, sponsorship, donor engagement, special events, and social media storytelling of Integration Charter Schools. Reporting directly to the Chief Development & External Relations Officer, this individual plans events that inspire, stewards the sponsors and donors who invest in our students, and helps each of our schools tell its story across every social media platform. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator, resourceful problem-solver, and strong multitasker who lives the ICS Bar: no excuses, no ego, and a commitment to do whatever it takes for our children, families, and faculty.

  

Our Vision and The Bar

Our vision is to reimagine what public education can be: schools that serve not only as centers of learning, but as hubs of opportunity and transformation for children, families, and faculty. Our commitment is simple but radical: we will do **whatever it takes** to set the standard for excellence for kids and families, pushing beyond compliance, beyond expectation, and beyond convention. The bar is high by design. In this role, the Bar means:

* **Leading with Love and Liberation:** every event and every post honors our students' dignity and celebrates them as they are

* **Doing Whatever It Takes, No Excuses, No Ego:** when a vendor cancels, a deadline moves, or a moment needs capturing at 7 p.m., you find a way. You own the outcome, not the excuse

* **Modeling Collaboration and Coherence:** you work across the development team, school leaders, and partners so ICS shows up as one organization telling one story

* **Holding Ourselves and Each Other Accountable:** you track every commitment, follow through on every promise to a sponsor or donor, and report results honestly

* **Building Schools Where Belonging Is Non-Negotiable:** our events and social media reflect every child, family, and faculty member we serve

As the primary operational lead for our outpatient program, the Operations Coordinator oversees day-to-day administrative, facilities, technology, quality improvement, and revenue cycle functions to ensure seamless service delivery and client access to care. Acting as a vital liaison between clinical leadership, peer staff, internal departments, managed care organizations, and external vendors, you will manage operational workflows, Avatar administration, Federal Billing submissions, staff training, and performance reporting. * Ensure adherence to OASAS, OMH, Medicaid, Managed Care, HIPAA, and 42 CFR Part 2 regulations through regular chart audits, quality assurance reviews, and corrective action initiatives
* Build collaborative relationships with external providers, managed care organizations, and community partners while representing the program at outreach events and agency committees

Qualifications:

* Associate’s degree required, with a Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, public administration, human services, behavioral health, business administration, or a related field preferred

* Demonstrated ability to analyze data, prepare reports, monitor compliance, and manage multiple priorities with strong organizational, communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills
* Preferred knowledge of OASAS, OMH, Medicaid, Medicare, Managed Care regulations, quality improvement methodologies, and performance management systems
* Preferred experience with Federal Billing, revenue cycle management, utilization reporting, STARS, ePACES, Medicaid verification systems, grant-funded reporting, and supervising Peer Services

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager (Mechanical Engineer)
jobs.description:
**About Leo AI:**

Leo AI is building the AI engineer for physical product development. Our platform sits inside the CAD environment engineers already use and helps them design faster, source smarter, and stop repeating the same expensive mistakes. We work with industrial machinery manufacturers, aerospace and defense organizations, and hardware teams building real products that ship.

**About the role:**

We are looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer to join us as our Technical Customer Success Engineer. This is a chance to be part of the future of AI for engineering, at the very moment it is taking shape. You will be the engineering face of Leo AI: the person who understands how large engineering organizations actually work, speaks their language, and shows them how AI can change the way they design and build. If you want to see your work change how real engineers work, in front of real customers around the world, this is your opportunity.This is a hands-on, customer-facing role. You will run onboarding and technical workshops, support deployments at customer sites, present to engineering leadership, and bring what you learn back to our product and R&D teams. You will travel frequently to customer sites.The role suits a senior engineer who has lived inside established, process-heavy engineering companies and wants to move to the other side of the table: helping those companies adopt a new way of working.

**What you will do:**

* Own the entire relationship with customer engineering teams from onboarding through expansion
* Lead onboarding sessions, technical workshops, and training for mechanical engineers and their managers, on-site and remotely
* Present Leo AI to engineering leadership and translate customer design workflows into how Leo is deployed and used
* Act as the first line of support: understand real engineering problems, reproduce them, and work with R&D to resolve them
* Gather product feedback from the field and turn it into clear, prioritized input for the product team
* Build demos, playbooks, and reference material based on real customer use cases
* Travel regularly to customer sites (expect significant travel)
  

**What we are looking for:**

* B.Sc. or higher in Mechanical Engineering - MUST
* At least 4 years of hands-on mechanical engineering experience, with a meaningful part of it spent in design and development work, not only documentation or drafting
* Experience in at least one large, established engineering organization, including working within its processes, approvals, and bureaucracy
* Customer-facing experience, and genuine comfort presenting to and leading discussions with senior engineers and managers
* Willingness and ability to travel on a regular basis
* Independent and responsible: you own outcomes, manage your own schedule, and need little direction
* Business-oriented: you recognize opportunities for growth and expansion within customer accounts and know how to turn them into real results

  

**Nice to have:**

* Diverse background: experience across different engineering companies
* Experience with a wide variety of CAD and PLM tools used in large engineering organizations (SolidWorks, NX, CATIA, Creo, Teamcenter, Windchill, etc.)
* Prior experience in a customer success, application engineering, field engineering, or solutions engineering role at a B2B software company

**Featured benefits**

Medical insurance, 401(k)

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (NY)
jobs.description:
### **Help build Luzmo's outbound engine in the US — from Brooklyn**

Luzmo is a fast-growing SaaS company operating across Europe and the US. We help software companies embed analytics, dashboards, and AI-powered data experiences directly into their products — so their users can make smarter decisions, faster.

We're a Leuven-based scale-up with a product that developers and product teams genuinely love, an ambitious international team, and real traction with customers ranging from Series B SaaS companies to Fortune 500 enterprises.

Our Brooklyn office at 77 Sands Street is where Luzmo's US story is being built. As our NY SDR, you'll be one of the first people shaping how we grow in North America.

### **The role**

This is a predominantly phone-based outbound role focused on creating qualified pipeline for our US Account Executives. You'll spend a meaningful part of your day speaking with prospective customers, qualifying opportunities, and opening doors.

You won't be working from cold lists alone. Our outbound motion is supported by a marketing and data engine that surfaces intent signals and high-potential accounts. Your job is to turn that intelligence into real conversations.

Beyond execution, we want someone who helps shape how outbound is done at Luzmo — testing messaging, improving targeting, and feeding insights back to the team.

### **What you'll do**

* Proactively connect with prospective customers by phone, email, and LinkedIn every day
* Qualify inbound and outbound opportunities generated through our marketing and data engine
* Research and identify SaaS companies that are a strong fit for Luzmo
* Engage decision-makers including VP Product, VP Engineering, CTOs, and Heads of Data
* Work closely with AEs to generate, qualify, and hand off pipeline
* Contribute ideas to improve our outbound strategy and messaging
* 3 days/week in our Brooklyn office at 77 Sands Street — hybrid the rest

### **Who we're looking for**

* Outgoing, quick thinker who genuinely enjoys connecting with people
* Strong work ethic: you take initiative, prioritize your tasks, and get things done
* Superior verbal and written communication skills
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment
* Sharp analytical and quantitative capabilities
* A self-starter used to working in a scrappy, resourceful team
* High interest in technology and the SaaS space

### **How we work**

* Trust. Many of us work from home and we rely on each other without constant oversight. We're against micromanagement and let our output do the talking. We celebrate every win, big or small.
* Team. We're a distributed, global workforce. We communicate directly but kindly, respect each other's space, and never schedule meetings just for the sake of it.
* Challenge. We're up against well-known players in a maturing industry — and our disruptor mindset is what drives us forward together.

### **What you'll earn**

* Base salary: $50,000–$60,000 depending on experience
* Variable: additional $15,000–$25,000 OTE on top
* Healthcare coverage
* Unlimited PTO
* Equipment and tooling fully covered
* Clear path to Account Executive — we promote from within

We keep things moving — from first contact to offer in about three weeks:

* HR screen & interview — week 1
* Hiring manager interview — week 2
* Business case + reference check — week 3
* Offer — week 3

**Job Description**

The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) oversees housing standards across all 3.7 million homes in New York City.

Under Commissioner Dina Levy and the Mamdani Administration, HPD is pursuing an ambitious housing agenda focused on the needs of New York’s tenants. With a broad set of tools including standards enforcement, tenant resources, and the creation of new affordable housing, HPD is committed to making New York City a more affordable place for renters and homeowners alike.  
  
  
  
Your Team:

OENS uses enforcement tools within its Division of Code Enforcement, Housing Litigation Division, Emergency Operations and Enhanced Enforcement, and the Division of Neighborhood Preservation to ensure compliance with legal and regulatory obligations.
  
  
The Office of Enforcement of Neighborhood Services is composed of seven divisions: Data Management & Technology (DMT), Division of Neighborhood Preservation (DNP), Administration & Internal Compliance (AIC), Housing Litigation Division (HLD), Division of Code Enforcement (DCE), Emergency Operations and Enhanced Enforcement Division (EOD)

* Assisting with seamless coordination and implementation of initiative-led projects.

  

* Reviewing operational methods and procedures to ensure completeness, compliance, and accuracy of program requirements.

  

* Participating in the refinement of existing reporting metrics and drive the development of new metrics to track initiative success.

  

* Assisting in the preparation, analysis, and refinement of operational materials for program improvement projects, delivering data-driven recommendations for procedure enhancements.

  

* Performing other tasks and handle strategic, ad-hoc projects as assigned by the Director.

  
Preferred Skills and Qualifications
  
  

* Experience: 3-5 years of experience in project coordination, community program management, or a related analyst role.

  

* Analytical Skills: Strong ability to evaluate reports, analyze system requirements, and interpret operational data.

  

* Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for preparing materials, reports, and strategic recommendations.

  

* Organization: Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple project timelines and shifting mandates simultaneously.

  

* Software Proficiency: Strong skills in project management tools and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

1. A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and two years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties described above; or

Nourishing Hope is a Chicago nonprofit working to end food hunger and address its root causes. Founded in 1970, we have evolved from a traditional food pantry into a comprehensive organization providing nutritious food, social services, and mental health support to individuals and families across Chicago.

We support the whole person with with respect, dignity, and compassion through:

  

* Five food access programs providing monthly groceries—including fresh produce, protein, grains, canned goods and other pantry staples—plus Bonus distributions offering additional food throughout the month.
