jobs.title: Event Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
**Plan it. Run it. Make them say “Wow!”**

Are you the one everyone hands the planning to? The person who spots the misspelt name badge, the coffee running low and the speaker who looks nervous, and quietly fixes all three before anyone else notices? Maybe you've spent a couple of years supporting events, and you're ready to run your own. Or maybe you've been the organised one on an executive support team and realised the events were the best part of the job.

If you want to put your own creative stamp on events that leaders, clients and colleagues remember, this is a great place to start.

TransPerfect runs a world-class events program: hundreds of events a year, from conferences, forums and panels to thought-leadership sessions and internal summits. They're local, regional, national and international, and every one is a little different. That variety is the point. You'll get real ownership, a portfolio of events to call your own, and a budget to make them impressive.

As part of our Global Marketing and Communications team, you'll lead some events yourself and join the team on others, learning from experienced event leaders as you go. Either way, you'll be trusted with the details that make an event great and encouraged to bring the ideas that make it unforgettable. And yes, you'll travel and see new places regularly.

**Day to day, you'll:**

* **Run your own events.** Take a portfolio of internal and external events from first idea through planning to delivery, with an impeccable eye for detail at every step.
* **Make your mark.** Bring fresh, creative ideas to every event you oversee, so attendees leave saying “Wow!”
* **Make the budget work hard.** Own the budget for your events and get the most out of every pound and dollar while keeping the experience impressive.
* **Get the best from our partners.** Work with TransPerfect's key suppliers to get real value from those relationships, both on cost and on the service we receive.
* **Know why every event exists.** Work closely with key stakeholders, the executive support team and other internal teams to understand the business goals behind each event, and make sure they're met.
* **Keep everything visible.** Use our proprietary online event management platform to track processes, costs and tasks, giving senior management a clear view of the whole program.
* **Be there when it happens.** Supervise events on-site, so they run smoothly, efficiently and on schedule.
* Some events you'll run on your own or with a small team behind you. On others, you'll be part of a team supporting another lead. Both will make you better at this.

**What's the directive? Sweat the details, bring the ideas, and make people say “Wow!”**

**What matters most**

Hands-on event experience and the instinct to go the extra mile. We want to hear about events you've helped plan and run: the problems you solved before anyone noticed, the ideas you brought to the table, the moments you're proud of. You don't need to have done it all yet. You need the drive to learn fast, the organisation to keep a dozen moving parts on track, and the calm to keep smiling when one of them breaks.

**The measurables**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in marketing or a related field
* 2-4 years of proven events experience
* Prior work on events and/or in executive support
* Brand management or brand development experience
* Clear, confident communication, written and verbal
* Basic design skills (PowerPoint, Canva or similar)
* Highly organised, efficient and detail-oriented, with real respect for timelines, processes and structure
* Calm and effective under pressure, with tight deadlines and in high-stakes moments
* Confident, professional and personable with everyone from interns to C-level executives, inside and outside the company
* A service mindset and an excellence reflex: proactive, and always ready to go the extra mile
* Available to travel 10–20% of the time, sometimes at short notice

**Is this you?**

From the audience, events look effortless. Behind the scenes, they're early starts, late finishes, last-minute changes and a hundred small decisions nobody notices when they're done right. If that sounds like hard work, you're right. If it also sounds like fun, you'll fit right in. Do it well, and you'll build a portfolio of events that are clearly yours, and earn the chance to take on bigger ones.

*Applicants should be ready to share examples of events they've worked on and are proud of.*

jobs.description:
**Community Outreach and Engagement Specialist**

**Recovery Oriented Systems of Care (ROSC)**

PEER Services (peerservices.org) is a leading nonprofit provider of community-based substance use prevention and treatment services for Evanston, Maine, New Trier, Niles and Northfield Townships, and the north side of Chicago. As a licensed treatment provider since 1975, we have transformed the lives of thousands of teens and adults and helped them open the door to a healthier, brighter future.

**About ROSC**

In 2018, the Illinois Department of Human Services Division of Behavioral Health and Recovery (IDHS/DBHR) launched Recovery-Oriented Systems of Care (ROSC) Councils across Illinois to strengthen recovery supports and improve outcomes for individuals affected by substance use and co-occurring mental health conditions. ROSC Councils bring together community members, service providers, organizations, and individuals with lived experience to build recovery-ready communities. Through collaboration, education, and advocacy, ROSC Councils work to reduce stigma, advance harm reduction, promote evidence-based recovery practices, improve access to services, and reduce barriers to treatment and recovery.

**Position Summary**

The NCC ROSC Coalition is seeking a Part-Time Community Outreach and Engagement Specialist (ROSC-COES) to support outreach, partnership development, coalition coordination, communications, and projects throughout Northern Cook County. Working alongside the ROSC Coalition Coordinator, this individual will represent the coalition in the community and build relationships that strengthen recovery supports and reduce barriers to care.

*This is a non-clinical position and does not include counseling, case management, treatment services, or clinical interventions.*

The ROSC Community Outreach and Engagement Specialist supports the development and implementation of our Recovery Oriented Systems of Care Program in collaboration with the ROSC Coordinator, and reports to the SUD Program Manager.

The ROSC Community Outreach and Engagement Specialist has a unique and integral role as a member of the PEER ROSC. The ROSC-COES has lived experience with substance use recovery and is comfortable with appropriate self-disclosure and sharing pertinent information about their own recovery experiences with others to educate and build community support for people with substance use disorders. The ROSC-COES is encouraged to utilize their lived experience to connect with community members, and advocate for those in recovery from substance use. In addition, the ROSC-COES works with the ROSC Coordinator to educate staff, community members, and other stakeholders on the needs of those in recovery, the RSS model, and role in recovery. The ROSC-COES must be stable in their own recovery for a minimum of two years. The ROSC-COES abides by the ethical standards, basic values, principles, and guidelines for peer recovery support practice. Additionally, the ROSC-COES is responsible for assisting the ROSC Coordinator in cultivating and maintaining relationships with community partners, persons in recovery, and other stakeholders. The ROSC-COES provides administrative assistance, as directed by the SUD Services Director and ROSC Coordinator.

Job Duties:

**Community Engagement Specialist Responsibilities**

**Community Outreach & Partnership Development**

· Build and maintain partnerships with community organizations, healthcare and social service providers, schools, faith-based groups, businesses, and other stakeholders through outreach and consistent follow-up.

· Engage partners through phone calls, emails, and in-person meetings; represent the NCC ROSC Coalition at networking events, resource fairs, and community gatherings.

· Research community resources, partnership opportunities, and best practices to identify collaborative projects that strengthen recovery-oriented systems of care.

· Attend scheduled ROSC Coalition meetings, TA meetings, regional meetings, and statewide meetings.

**Coalition Support & Initiative Advancement**

· Assist with the implementation of coalition goals, deliverables, strategic initiatives, and projects assigned by the ROSC Coalition Coordinator.

· Support event planning, meeting logistics, and stakeholder engagement, including planning, coordinating, and co-facilitating the monthly Northern Cook County ROSC Coalition meeting.

· Prepare meeting minutes, organize electronic files and coalition records, and assist with data collection and reporting on coalition activities.

· Support statewide ROSC initiatives to reduce stigma, advance harm reduction, increase awareness of recovery services, reduce barriers to treatment and recovery, and strengthen community recovery supports and systems.

**Communications & Resource Development**

· Ensure the SUD Services Director and ROSC Coordinator are keep abreast of all aspects of ROSC activities. Offer suggestions that support the development of the program.

· Attend and participate in organizational, program, and team meetings and activities.

· Create presentations, flyers, newsletters, and other outreach materials using Canva and other digital communication tools.

· Assist with community education campaigns and awareness initiatives.

· Draft and distribute emails, meeting invitations, and outreach communications.

· Maintain community resource information and partnership databases.

· Complete special projects and other duties as assigned by the SUD Services Director and ROSC Coordinator.

Classification, Compensation, Work Schedule, and Benefits:

· This is a part-time, non-exempt, hourly position not to exceed 24 hours per week.

· Compensation is $19.00 to $24.00 per hour dependent on experience and qualifications.

· This is an on-site position, requiring travel to ROSC meetings and activities. Requires access to a car and insurance.

· Work hours will be based on the needs of the program and staff availability.

jobs.description:
**Full Time** position in 1 North Wacker Drive Chicago, IL, 60602

**Job Title: Account Executive-Digital Marketing (Home Services)**
  
*Location: Chicago, IL-Hybrid/Remote*

**If you've ever sold digital marketing to a small business owner and actually enjoyed it — this is the role you've been waiting for.**

**About Us:**

Predictive Sales AI builds AI-powered websites and digital marketing tools specifically for home services contractors — HVAC companies, plumbers, roofers, landscapers. We help them show up online, generate more leads, and grow their business. Our clients are owner-operators who work hard and need a marketing partner they can trust. That's where you come in.

**The Role:**

As a **Account Executive** you'll be selling PSAI's websites, SEO, PPC, and Google Ads services to home services business owners across South Florida and beyond. This is a consultative sale — you're not order-taking, you're helping contractors understand why their current marketing isn't working and showing them a better path.

You'll manage your own pipeline, run discovery calls, present proposals, and close deals. The sales cycle is typically 2–4 weeks. Most of your buyers are skeptical at first — they've been burned by marketing agencies before. Your job is to earn their trust fast and back it up with results.

**What You'll Do:**

* Prospect and develop your own pipeline through outreach, referrals, and warm leads from our marketing team
* Run discovery calls to understand a contractor's current marketing, pain points, and growth goals
* Present PSAI's digital marketing solutions — websites, SEO, PPC, Google Ads — and tailor proposals to each client's situation
* Handle objections from skeptical business owners who have been burned by agencies before
* Close deals and hand off to the client success team for onboarding
* Hit monthly revenue targets and maintain accurate pipeline records in CRM
* Stay current on digital marketing trends so you can speak credibly to clients about what actually works

**What We're Looking For:**

**Required:**

* 1–5 years of sales experience — digital marketing, SaaS, lead gen, or related field
* Comfortable selling to small business owners — you understand how they think and what they care about
* Strong phone and video presence — most of your outreach and demos will be remote
* Self-starter who can manage their own pipeline without being micromanaged
* Genuine interest in digital marketing — you don't need to be a technical expert but you need to care about the product
* Based in or commutable to Boca Raton, FL for hybrid work schedule

**Bonus Points:**

* Experience selling to home services contractors (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, landscaping)
* Background selling SEO, PPC, Google Ads, or website services
* Sold for a digital agency, lead gen platform (Angi, HomeAdvisor), or local marketing company
* Familiar with contractor objections — ROI conversations, skepticism of digital marketing, long decision cycles

**Who Success Here:**

The reps who thrive at PSAI are hunters. They're comfortable picking up the phone, handling a tough objection, and following up until they get a yes or a no. They're also genuine — contractor owners can smell a pitch from a mile away, and the best reps here build trust quickly by being real.

* You're a closer — you know how to create urgency without being pushy
* You're resilient — rejection doesn't derail you, it refocuses you
* You're curious — you ask good questions and actually listen to the answers
* You're coachable — you want feedback and use it to get better
* You're hungry — you're motivated by commission and want to control your own earnings

**Why PSAI?**

* **You're selling something that works.** Our clients see real results — more calls, more leads, more booked jobs. That makes every sales conversation easier.
* **The market is massive.** There are hundreds of thousands of home services contractors in the US and most of them have terrible marketing. The opportunity is enormous.
* **You control your earnings.** Competitive base plus uncapped commission. The more you close, the more you make.
* **You're hybrid.** Work from home most of the time with regular check-ins at our Boca Raton office. No five-day commute.
* **You'll grow.** We're a growing company — reps who perform get more responsibility, better accounts, and a real career path.

**Sound like you?**

Apply with your resume and tell us in 2–3 sentences about the toughest SMB sale you've ever closed — what made it hard and how you got it done. That's all we need to get started.

jobs.title: Roofing Sales Representative / Account Manager
jobs.description:
John Beal Roofing is hiring Roofing Sales Representatives in the Chicago Suburbs market. No roofing experience is required and we train you from the ground up. You do need to be comfortable working at height — you will be on roofs and ladders — and you need a valid driver's license and your own reliable transportation. Apply with the form on this page or call 1-800-564-6232.

**Now hiring in Chicago Suburbs.** The Chicago suburbs are one of the largest residential roofing markets in the country, with hail, lake-effect wind and freeze-thaw cycles working on millions of homes across DuPage, Will, Kane and Cook counties. John Beal Roofing is expanding into the Chicago Suburbs area and is looking for its first salesmen and account managers there — people who want to get in early, own a territory, and grow with the market.

This is the role that drives everything else at this company. You meet homeowners after a storm or at the end of a roof's life, get on the roof, document what you find, explain it in plain language, and carry the job through to a finished roof. **Earnings start at $100,000 a year** and are commission-based, so what you make follows what you sell and how well you take care of people.

**What you will actually do**
-----------------------------

* **Inspect roofs.** Get on the roof, photograph and measure damage, and document it slope by slope.
* **Educate, don't pressure.** Walk homeowners through what you found and what their options are. We sell by being the honest one in the driveway.
* **Work insurance claims.** Meet adjusters on site and make sure the scope reflects the damage the policy owes. We train you on this — it is the part most people have never done before.
* **Own the relationship.** Stay with your customer from the first inspection through the finished roof and the final walkthrough.
* **Build your territory** across Naperville, IL, Aurora, IL, Joliet, IL, Schaumburg, IL, Arlington Heights, IL, Orland Park, IL, Wheaton, IL, Elgin, IL and the surrounding Chicago Suburbs area.

**What we require**
-------------------

* **No experience necessary.** Some of our strongest people came from restaurants, retail, construction and the military.
* **You cannot be afraid of heights.** This job puts you on roofs. If that is a problem, this is the wrong role — and that is fine, we hire for other positions too.
* A valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
* Willingness to learn roofing, insurance and claims knowledge you can build a long career on.
* Comfort talking with homeowners and following through on what you promised.

**Why people stay here**
------------------------

* **Family-owned, not a storm-chaser.** The owner's name is on the building. You will meet him.
* **Year-round work.** 10+ local offices serving homeowners in five states means we are not idle when one area goes quiet.
* **Promotion from within.** Our managers came up through the field, not from a corporate transfer.
* **A brand that opens doors.** A BBB Torch Award for marketplace ethics and a lifetime workmanship warranty behind what you sell.
* **Real training.** Roofing, insurance and claims knowledge, taught here.

**Where you will work**
-----------------------

This position is based in the Chicago Suburbs market (the Chicago suburbs, IL), covering Naperville, IL, Aurora, IL, Joliet, IL, Schaumburg, IL, Arlington Heights, IL, Orland Park, IL, Wheaton, IL, Elgin, IL and the surrounding communities. Our hiring line for this market is 1-800-564-6232.

**How to apply**
----------------

Use the form on this page — it goes straight to our hiring team, with no portal and no account to create. You can also call 1-800-564-6232 or our main line at 1-800-564-6232. We are also hiring production crews, project managers, insurance claim specialists, commercial estimators and office staff — see all open positions.

**Frequently asked questions**
------------------------------

Do I need roofing experience to apply for this job?

No. No experience is required. We train you on roofing, inspections, insurance and claims. Experience is welcome but work ethic matters more.

Do I have to get on the roof?

Yes. Inspecting and documenting roofs is a core part of this role, so you cannot be afraid of heights. If heights are a problem, ask us about our office, estimating and project management roles instead.

How much does this job pay?

Earnings start at $100,000 a year. The role is commission-based, so what you sell drives what you make. We go through the specifics during the interview.

Which cities does this position cover?

The Chicago Suburbs market, including Naperville, IL, Aurora, IL, Joliet, IL, Schaumburg, IL, Arlington Heights, IL, Orland Park, IL, Wheaton, IL, Elgin, IL and surrounding communities.

How do I apply?

Submit the form on this page or call 1-800-564-6232. It goes directly to our hiring team — no portal, no account.

jobs.description:
Korwitts Chiropractic, P.C. is an established, patient-centered chiropractic and wellness practice in Downers Grove, IL. We pride ourselves on high clinical integrity, authentic patient education, and transparent communication. We are looking for a detail-oriented, tech-savvy local **Marketing, Content & Social Media Coordinator** to manage our organic social media, short-form video creation, Meta lead generation ads, and routine WordPress website updates.

Ideally, you love the natural wellness industry and are familiar with chiropractic and related services. This is a part-time position involving 12-15 hours a week with potential to grow. You will be on-site 1-2 days per week with some remote flexibility. You must be located in the Chicago area.

### **To Apply**

* **Portfolio Check:** Along with your Resume. Share links or examples of 2–3 social media posts, Reels, or ad graphics you personally created and managed for a business page. Briefly note what tools you used.
* **Compliance & Approval Scenario:** In healthcare marketing, promotional offers (such as a discounted new-patient exam) require specific legal disclaimers and strict adherence to approved clinical services. How do you structure your pre-launch checklist to guarantee that zero unapproved offers or missing disclaimers ever go live?
* **Platform & WordPress Comfort:** We do have a WordPress website, and you will be doing updates and additions to the site along with working with our social media content. Are you experienced managing organic Facebook and Instagram calendars through Meta Business Suite, running lead ads inside a client-owned Meta Business Manager account, and editing pages inside WordPress (specifically Elementor)?

 **Compensation:**

$20 - $25 hourly

 **Responsibilities:**

**What You Will Do:**

* **Facebook & Instagram Page Management & Content Creation:** Plan, design, schedule, and publish consistent weekly organic content across our Facebook and Instagram accounts (educational graphics, posture/mobility tips, clinic updates, and community highlights) using tools like Canva and Meta Business Suite. Monitor comments and direct messages promptly and professionally, routing any clinical or scheduling inquiries to our front desk.
* **In-Clinic Video Capture & Editing:** Visit our Downers Grove clinic 1–2 times per week to film crisp, natural vertical videos (Reels/Shorts) of Dr. Korwitts, patient education clips, clinic culture, and approved patient testimonials. Edit cleanly (CapCut/Premiere/Canva) with accurate captions and natural color—no heavy AI face-warping or over-processed filters.
* **Meta (Facebook & Instagram) Lead Ads:** Build, monitor, and optimize local lead-generation campaigns inside **our clinic’s Meta Business Manager** (the clinic retains full ownership of all ad accounts, pixels, and billing).
* **Healthcare Compliance & Pre-Approval:** Strictly adhere to healthcare marketing compliance—including mandatory federal Medicare/Medicaid exclusions on promotional offers and signed patient media releases—and submit all content calendars, ad copy, graphics, and videos for written sign-off from leadership before publishing.
* **WordPress / Elementor Website Updates:** Perform routine front-end updates on our WordPress/Elementor website (swapping images, posting educational blogs/condition pages using existing templates, and verifying contact forms). Hosting infrastructure and server security are managed separately by our HIPAA-compliant host.

 **Qualifications:**

**Who You Are:**

* **Detail-Obsessed & Compliance-Minded:** You double-check every frame of a video and every line of ad copy before hitting publish. You never push unapproved changes or offers live.
* **Strong Eye for Authentic Visuals:** You know how to shoot clean smartphone video with good lighting and audio, and your portfolio shows natural, polished edits rather than blurry or distorted AI templates.
* **Experienced With Meta Ads Manager & WordPress:** You are comfortable navigating Meta Ads Manager lead forms, basic audience targeting, and WordPress page builders (Elementor experience is a big plus).
* **Reliable & Local:** Able to commute reliably to Downers Grove, IL 1–2 mornings or afternoons per week for filming and brief team check-ins.

 **About Company**

Since 1987, Korwitts Chiropractic Center has served Downers Grove and the western suburbs with one guiding mission: helping people live healthier, more active, and more fulfilling lives. Our multidisciplinary team brings together a wide range of natural healthcare services, all designed to address the underlying causes of health concerns while supporting the unique needs of each patient. While our treatment approaches may vary, they are united by a common philosophy: every individual deserves personalized care, education, and the opportunity to achieve the highest level of health possible.

**Job Function:** Sales
  
  
**Job Family:** Inside Sales
  
**Job:** Inside Sales & Service Representative
  
  
Position Summary
  
The Service Inside Sales Representative is responsible for proactively growing service revenue by identifying, developing, and closing service opportunities across the Natus Sensory customer base and targeted prospective customers.
  
  
This role serves as a dedicated commercial resource for service and combines customer outreach, service-contract expertise, opportunity management, quoting, follow-up, and partnership with the field sales and service organizations.
  
The primary goal is to build a scalable inside-sales engine that protects existing service revenue, increases customer penetration, and creates new recurring service revenue by systematically turning Natus's installed base, warranty expirations, renewals, win-backs, and competitive opportunities into closed business.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Proactive Service Sales
  

* Conduct proactive outbound customer outreach against prioritized service-sales campaigns and call lists.
* Identify and pursue opportunities for:
* Service contract renewals
* Warranty-to-service-contract conversions
* Multi-year service agreements
* Calibration-to-contract conversions
* Win-back opportunities
* Lapsed or expired warranty opportunities
* Competitive service and calibration opportunities
* Engage customers approaching warranty, calibration, or service-contract expiration.
* Explain Natus service offerings and clearly communicate their value, including predictable service costs, equipment uptime, planned maintenance and calibration, and continuity of coverage.
* Consistently follow up on open quotes and customer opportunities through decision or closure.

Quoting and Opportunity Management
  

* Prepare accurate service quotes using approved pricing, service packages, and quoting tools.
* Work with customers to determine appropriate coverage, contract duration, equipment, and billing structure.
* Maintain visibility to the service-sales funnel and actively manage opportunities from identification through close.
* Escalate pricing, contracting, or operational barriers that may prevent an otherwise viable service opportunity from closing.

Customer and Install-Base Development
  

* Use customer, asset, warranty, service-history, and install-base information to identify whitespace and growth opportunities.
* Identify customer equipment that is approaching warranty expiration or is not currently covered under a service agreement.
* Identify customers receiving calibration-only service who may benefit from broader service-contract coverage.
* Support campaigns designed to penetrate the existing install base and identify competitive equipment and new service opportunities.

**Position Summary**  
The Supply & Logistics Coordinator supports daily fuel supply, logistics, inventory management, reporting, cost analysis, and delivery coordination for Road Ranger Travel Centers and potential wholesale customers. This role works closely with suppliers, terminals, common carriers, third-party logistics providers, internal operations, and the Vice President of Fuels to ensure reliable supply, accurate reporting, efficient deliveries, and cost-effective fuel sourcing.

* Coordinate and secure fuel supply at various terminals.

* Prepare analytics, dashboards, and PowerPoint presentations related to fuel costs, inventory, supplier pricing, logistics performance, and operational activity.
* Support executive-level and board-level reporting and presentations as needed.
* Maintain confidentiality of company pricing, supply, logistics, and financial information.
* Perform special projects and other departmental duties as assigned.

**Schedule Requirements**  
This position requires in- office M-F 7:00 am- 5:00 PM. Additional participation in a nightly supply sourcing rotation and weekend rotation responsibilities, including fuel inventory management, delivery forecasting, order creation, delivery amendments, and on-call support for supply issues and common carrier coordination which may be performed remotely.  
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Logistics, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in supply chain, logistics, transportation, fuel supply, or related operations.
* Experience in general accounting, financial reporting, reconciliation, and business analysis in a corporate environment preferred.
* Experience with ERP systems, PDI, inventory systems, or fuel management platforms preferred.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Strong organizational skills with strict attention to detail.
* Ability to work under pressure, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple competing deadlines.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
* Expert proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
* Advanced-Expert level Excel skills, including spreadsheet development, pivot tables, VLOOKUP, data analysis, reporting, and database management.
* Strong PowerPoint slide creation skills, including executive-level and board-level presentation development.
* Strong data analytics skills, including Power BI, dashboards, reporting, and trend analysis.
* Comfortable presenting analytics, findings, and recommendations to leadership and board-level audiences.
* Flexible, process-oriented, and able to identify opportunities for operational improvement.
* High degree of confidentiality, professionalism, and accountability.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Fuel supply, petroleum, terminal, or common carrier logistics experience.
* Experience with PDI or other fuel accounting and inventory management systems.
* Knowledge of fuel pricing, rack pricing, freight costs, inventory levels, and delivery scheduling.

The Supply & Logistics Coordinator supports reliable fuel supply, accurate inventory levels, efficient logistics execution, supplier and carrier coordination, and cost-effective fuel operations across Road Ranger Travel Centers and wholesale fuel customers.

About Us

The Roxbury Institute, in conjunction with the Advanced Lipedema Treatment (ALT) Program, is dedicated to providing exceptional, comprehensive care and innovative treatment options for patients with lipedema and related conditions. This individual will serve as the primary point of contact for prospective patients interested in surgical treatment with our surgeons, managing incoming calls, inquiries, and leads from initial contact through consultation scheduling and continued follow-up.

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to confidently communicate with patients and medical professionals.

* Quarterly bonus structure based on established sales and performance KPIs.
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401(k).

**Cuttable exists because creativity shouldn’t be what slows marketing teams down.**

The world’s biggest advertising platforms demand more ads than most teams can produce. But production is still slow, expensive and built for a different era. Briefs pile up. Creative teams burn out. Marketers can’t keep up.

Cuttable fixes that.

We’re an AI Creative Production System that helps ecommerce brands create, test and launch ads across Meta, TikTok and Google at the volume the platforms actually reward.

More than 300 brands across North America and Asia Pacific already use Cuttable. We’re backed by Square Peg, Rampersand and AirTree, following one of the largest seed rounds in Australian tech history. Offices in Melbourne and New York.

Our CEO and co-founder, Sam Kroonenburg, has built and scaled a global technology company before. Now we’re doing it again.

**Join us and help make good ads, instantly.**

### **The role**

**Pay range: $101,000 – $151,000 USD per year** — the range we reasonably expect to pay for this role at hire.

As Cuttable scales its US customer base, our customers need someone who owns their success long after onboarding. As a Customer Success Manager, you’ll own retention, adoption and expansion across a book of US customers from day 90 onward, including every renewal in that book. You’ll be the trusted advisor customers call for ideas, not just support, and you’ll treat retention and growth as your number, acting independently and never waiting for permission to save or grow an account.

* Your number: hitting or beating your renewal and expansion quota once it is set in Q1 2027.

* Product adoption and expansion (more brands, more users, bigger plans and more of customers’ spend on Cuttable creative) by tying Cuttable to the numbers they care about, like ROAS and CPA.

* Business reviews and success plans that make the value obvious to decision-makers at every level, from paid social leads to CMOs.
* Customer advocacy: referrals, case studies and champions inside customer teams.
* Smart prioritisation, so multi-brand teams and fast-moving single brands each get the attention that matches what’s at stake.
* Improvements to our renewal and expansion playbook, contributing what’s working in your book as we build the motion in the US.

**Who you’ll support**

* Implementation Managers, by agreeing a clean day-90 handover so customers never feel the change of owner.
* Account Executives, by flagging expansion opportunities and sharing account context ahead of commercial conversations.
* Product, by sharing customer feedback, feature requests and patterns you see across your book.
* Newer team members, through informal mentoring, coaching and empathetic feedback.
* The Customer Success Director, with input on how CSM quotas and variable comp should be measured.

**What success looks like at six months**

* Customers are using more of Cuttable (more brands, more users, more of their spend on Cuttable creative) because you tied it to the numbers they care about, like ROAS and CPA.
* Revenue across your book is growing, and you saw at-risk renewals coming well before they landed.
* Customers call you for advice, not just support. You bring ideas before they ask and do what you say you’ll do.
* Your time matches what’s at stake: multi-brand teams and fast-moving single brands each get the attention they need.
* Your best customers are your best pipeline, referring peers, joining case studies and championing Cuttable inside their own teams.
* You’re on track to hit or exceed your quota from Q1 2027, and you’ve contributed to a renewal and expansion playbook the team uses.

### **Who we look for**

We hire for values as much as experience, because mindset carries you through the parts no job description can predict. Here’s what that looks like day to day at Cuttable:

* **Be Brave & Own It**: you take smart risks and you own what happens next, good or bad. You own the outcome, not just the intention.
* **Create Customer Magic**: you listen hard enough to get to what customers actually need, not just what they said.
* **Say It (With Care)**: You say the honest thing, directly, and with genuine care for the person hearing it.
* **Progress Beats Perfection**: you’d rather ship, learn, and improve than sit on something waiting for it to be flawless.
* **Work Hard, Laugh Often**: you take the work seriously. Never yourself.

We believe you’ll succeed in this role if you have:

* Demonstrated experience as a Customer Success Manager, Account Manager or Account Executive in B2B SaaS, with a track record of growing revenue through renewals, expansion and product adoption, and of hitting or beating your number.
* Experience managing a mix of account sizes, from fast-moving brands to multi-stakeholder teams, and the ability to build trust with decision-makers at every level, from paid social leads to CMOs.
* Strong storytelling: business reviews and success plans that make the value obvious.
* A data-driven way of running your book. Usage, health and engagement tell you where to focus, and you know when to pull in peers or the Customer Success Director for help.
* Comfort using tools like HubSpot, Intercom (or similar), Notion, Loom and Slack.
* Bonus: working knowledge of performance ma

**Organization Overview**

Nourishing Hope is a Chicago nonprofit working to end food hunger and address its root causes. Founded in 1970, we have evolved from a traditional food pantry into a comprehensive organization providing nutritious food, social services, and mental health support to individuals and families across Chicago.

We support the whole person with with respect, dignity, and compassion through:

  

* Five food access programs providing monthly groceries—including fresh produce, protein, grains, canned goods and other pantry staples—plus Bonus distributions offering additional food throughout the month.
* Home delivery for older adults, homebound neighbors and neighbors living with disabilities.

new_jobs.description:
**Full Time** position in 1 North Wacker Drive Chicago, IL, 60602

**Job Title: Account Executive-Digital Marketing (Home Services)**
  
*Location: Chicago, IL-Hybrid/Remote*

**If you've ever sold digital marketing to a small business owner and actually enjoyed it — this is the role you've been waiting for.**

**About Us:**

Predictive Sales AI builds AI-powered websites and digital marketing tools specifically for home services contractors — HVAC companies, plumbers, roofers, landscapers. We help them show up online, generate more leads, and grow their business. Our clients are owner-operators who work hard and need a marketing partner they can trust. That's where you come in.

**The Role:**

As a **Account Executive** you'll be selling PSAI's websites, SEO, PPC, and Google Ads services to home services business owners across South Florida and beyond. This is a consultative sale — you're not order-taking, you're helping contractors understand why their current marketing isn't working and showing them a better path.

You'll manage your own pipeline, run discovery calls, present proposals, and close deals. The sales cycle is typically 2–4 weeks. Most of your buyers are skeptical at first — they've been burned by marketing agencies before. Your job is to earn their trust fast and back it up with results.

**What You'll Do:**

* Prospect and develop your own pipeline through outreach, referrals, and warm leads from our marketing team
* Run discovery calls to understand a contractor's current marketing, pain points, and growth goals
* Present PSAI's digital marketing solutions — websites, SEO, PPC, Google Ads — and tailor proposals to each client's situation
* Handle objections from skeptical business owners who have been burned by agencies before
* Close deals and hand off to the client success team for onboarding
* Hit monthly revenue targets and maintain accurate pipeline records in CRM
* Stay current on digital marketing trends so you can speak credibly to clients about what actually works

**What We're Looking For:**

**Required:**

* 1–5 years of sales experience — digital marketing, SaaS, lead gen, or related field
* Comfortable selling to small business owners — you understand how they think and what they care about
* Strong phone and video presence — most of your outreach and demos will be remote
* Self-starter who can manage their own pipeline without being micromanaged
* Genuine interest in digital marketing — you don't need to be a technical expert but you need to care about the product
* Based in or commutable to Boca Raton, FL for hybrid work schedule

**Bonus Points:**

* Experience selling to home services contractors (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, landscaping)
* Background selling SEO, PPC, Google Ads, or website services
* Sold for a digital agency, lead gen platform (Angi, HomeAdvisor), or local marketing company
* Familiar with contractor objections — ROI conversations, skepticism of digital marketing, long decision cycles

**Who Success Here:**

The reps who thrive at PSAI are hunters. They're comfortable picking up the phone, handling a tough objection, and following up until they get a yes or a no. They're also genuine — contractor owners can smell a pitch from a mile away, and the best reps here build trust quickly by being real.

* You're a closer — you know how to create urgency without being pushy
* You're resilient — rejection doesn't derail you, it refocuses you
* You're curious — you ask good questions and actually listen to the answers
* You're coachable — you want feedback and use it to get better
* You're hungry — you're motivated by commission and want to control your own earnings

**Why PSAI?**

* **You're selling something that works.** Our clients see real results — more calls, more leads, more booked jobs. That makes every sales conversation easier.
* **The market is massive.** There are hundreds of thousands of home services contractors in the US and most of them have terrible marketing. The opportunity is enormous.
* **You control your earnings.** Competitive base plus uncapped commission. The more you close, the more you make.
* **You're hybrid.** Work from home most of the time with regular check-ins at our Boca Raton office. No five-day commute.
* **You'll grow.** We're a growing company — reps who perform get more responsibility, better accounts, and a real career path.

**Sound like you?**

Apply with your resume and tell us in 2–3 sentences about the toughest SMB sale you've ever closed — what made it hard and how you got it done. That's all we need to get started.

**Supply & Logistics Coordinator**  
**Reports to:** Vice President of Fuels  
**Department:** Fuels / Supply & Logistics  
  
**Position Summary**  
The Supply & Logistics Coordinator supports daily fuel supply, logistics, inventory management, reporting, cost analysis, and delivery coordination for Road Ranger Travel Centers and potential wholesale customers. This role works closely with suppliers, terminals, common carriers, third-party logistics providers, internal operations, and the Vice President of Fuels to ensure reliable supply, accurate reporting, efficient deliveries, and cost-effective fuel sourcing.  
The position also supports ERP/PDI system accuracy, supplier pricing analysis, nightly supply sourcing on a team rotation, executive reporting, and special projects as assigned.  
  
**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Reconcile, analyze, and report daily fuel activity for Road Ranger Travel Centers.
* Develop and maintain weekly and monthly fuel accounting, inventory, logistics, and cost reports.
* Schedule, coordinate, and monitor fuel deliveries for Road Ranger locations and wholesale customers.
* Coordinate communication and performance follow-up with suppliers, terminals, common carriers, and third-party logistics providers.
* Monitor inventory levels, demand trends, supply availability, and delivery requirements to support timely fuel ordering and execution.
* Coordinate and secure fuel supply at various terminals.
* Participate in nightly supply sourcing as part of a Monday through Friday team rotation.
* Assist the Vice President of Fuels with product sourcing, supplier pricing analysis, fuel cost reporting, and supply strategy.
* Support ERP/PDI system setup, data entry, process improvements, and ongoing system accuracy.
* Prepare analytics, dashboards, and PowerPoint presentations related to fuel costs, inventory, supplier pricing, logistics performance, and operational activity.
* Support executive-level and board-level reporting and presentations as needed.
* Maintain confidentiality of company pricing, supply, logistics, and financial information.
* Perform special projects and other departmental duties as assigned.

**Schedule Requirements**  
This position requires in- office M-F 7:00 am- 5:00 PM. Additional participation in a nightly supply sourcing rotation and weekend rotation responsibilities, including fuel inventory management, delivery forecasting, order creation, delivery amendments, and on-call support for supply issues and common carrier coordination which may be performed remotely.  
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Logistics, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in supply chain, logistics, transportation, fuel supply, or related operations.
* Experience in general accounting, financial reporting, reconciliation, and business analysis in a corporate environment preferred.
* Experience with ERP systems, PDI, inventory systems, or fuel management platforms preferred.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Strong organizational skills with strict attention to detail.
* Ability to work under pressure, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple competing deadlines.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
* Expert proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
* Advanced-Expert level Excel skills, including spreadsheet development, pivot tables, VLOOKUP, data analysis, reporting, and database management.
* Strong PowerPoint slide creation skills, including executive-level and board-level presentation development.
* Strong data analytics skills, including Power BI, dashboards, reporting, and trend analysis.
* Comfortable presenting analytics, findings, and recommendations to leadership and board-level audiences.
* Flexible, process-oriented, and able to identify opportunities for operational improvement.
* High degree of confidentiality, professionalism, and accountability.
